leadText:
Brittany (Japanese: チヒロ Chihiro) is a character of the day who appeared in Same Old Song and Dance.

 and stumbled across Brittany while she was practicing a song-and-dance routine with her twin , nicknamed Gigglybiff and Gigglybuff. recognized Brittany as being the host of a talk show with her name, as well as the singer of the group Brittany and the Loony Balloons. Brittany invited all of them to her concert later that evening.

At the concert, appeared and stole the Igglybuff twins, along with . While Ash and went with Brittany to look for the stolen Pokémon, Brock entertained the crowd with a song.

Soon, the Igglybuff twins were returned safely to Brittany, and the concert continued on as planned. Afterwards, Jigglypuff decided to perform using and put everyone to sleep.

==Pokémon==
 
 

==Voice actors==
 

==Trivia==
 
Her Japanese name, Chihiro, is a possible reference to idol singer , while her English name, Brittany, is a possible reference to the famous pop star .
Brittany is somewhat similar to Bailey in the fact that she had two of the same Pokémon that performed together. Also, both of their pairs of Pokémon have nicknames that are similar to their partners. (Bailey owns two named Belle and Bella. Brittany's are named Gigglybiff and Gigglybuff.) 
One of the girls seen in the Striaton Gym in Triple Leaders, Team Threats! has a striking resemblance to Brittany.
